mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, product_id, created_at, deleted_at FROM user_favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_favorites (user_id, product_id, created_at, deleted_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{createdAt}, #{deletedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_favorites SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_id, p.merchant_id, p.product_name, p.brand, p.category, p.tea_tags, p.origin_place, p.flavor_profile, p.price, p.stock_quantity, p.warning_stock, p.compatible_devices, p.description, p.image_url, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.is_deleted, COALESCE(rs.average_rating, 0) AS average_rating, COALESCE(rs.review_count, 0) AS review_count FROM user_favorites uf JOIN products p ON p.product_id = uf.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT product_id, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS average_rating, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM product_reviews WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY product_id ) rs ON rs.product_id = p.product_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND uf.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorites WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
